test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Two trains are moving in the same direction at the speed of 36 km/hr and 48 km/hr. The time taken by faster train to cross a man sitting in the slower train is 33 seconds. What will be the length of the faster train?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 36 km/h and 48 km/h

Time = 33 seconds

**Formula used:**

Relative speed of trains moving in same direction is subtraction of their speeds.

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 48 - 36 = 12 km/h = 3.33 m/sec

Length of the faster train = 33 x 3.33 = 110m

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
